preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ini < outi < 2 * n for ini, outi, _, _, _ in parcels) and all(0 <= wi <= 1000 and 0 <= si <= 1000 and 1 <= vi <= 10**6 for _, _, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: Each parcel has valid time bounds (ini < outi < 2n), weight (0 ≤ wi ≤ 1000), strength (0 ≤ si ≤ 1000), and value (1 ≤ vi ≤ 10^6).

preconditions.expression: len(parcels) == n and 1 <= n <= 500 and 0 <= S <= 1000
preconditions.description: Input contains exactly n parcels (1 ≤ n ≤ 500) and platform strength S (0 ≤ S ≤ 1000).

preconditions.expression: all(ini != inj or outi != outj for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) for ini, outi, _, _, _ in [parcels[i], parcels[j]])
preconditions.description: No two parcels share both arrival time (ini) and delivery time (outi).

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum total value (in bourles) achievable by optimally selecting and delivering parcels.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= total_weight <= S for total_weight in platform_weights) and all(weight_above <= strength for weight_above, strength in zip(weight_above_stack, strengths_stack))
postconditions.description: For every valid state in the optimal solution, the total weight on the platform never exceeds S, and each box's strength is ≥ the total weight of boxes above it.

postconditions.expression: max_bourles == sum(vi for i, (ini, outi, wi, si, vi) in enumerate(parcels) if selected[i])
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of values (vi) of all parcels selected for delivery at their exact outi time in the optimal solution.

postconditions.expression: all(ini <= outi for i, (ini, outi, _, _, _) in enumerate(parcels) if selected[i])
postconditions.description: Every selected parcel is delivered at or after its arrival time (ini ≤ outi).

postconditions.expression: all(parcels[i][0] == parcels[j][0] or parcels[i][1] == parcels[j][1] or (parcels[i][0] != parcels[j][0] and parcels[i][1] != parcels[j][1]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if selected[i] and selected[j])
postconditions.description: No two selected parcels share both arrival and delivery times (ensures no ambiguity in delivery order).
